comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. GitHub #641 (mitcad#2384; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/shell-reported-test.cmake): a three-way pipe. Loft1 (F4) from a circle of diameter 340 on Plane1, 315 above XY (Sketch1, on the z axis), to a circle of diameter 170 on XY centred at x = 225 (Sketch2), Tangent Edges Merge; Extrude7 (F19) pulls its top 60 up, Extrude8 (F20) its bottom 15 down; Mirror3 (F21) mirrors the body about YZ and joins it; Fillet5 (F22) rounds the crotch with 20. The marker stands after Fillet5 (the features after it are rolled back). The section of the loft's side with its mirror image ended 4.2 micrometres short of the top, where the two sides share their tangent plane, and the geometry kernel's union kept the loft alone, so Mirror3 said ok on half the body and Fillet5 found no crotch (OCCT port patch 2384 puts the section's end on the boundary).

Both arms: x from -310 to 310. The union's volume: every horizontal section of the loft is a disc centred at x >= 0, so the union's half at x >= 0 is the loft's own half there (twice it: 27 047 311.33, integrated over the height), and the top extrusion lies on its mirror image (pi 170^2 60), the bottom ones apart (2 pi 85^2 15).
The volume without Fillet5, which adds material in the crotch.
The crotch found and rounded on the joined body, both arms still there.
The reporter's Shell of the three ends, 5 mm inside, Rounded, Tangent Chain on: one body.

The same Shell Sharp, as the reporter made it (mitcad#2418): it failed ('the offset faces do not close up'). The rims where the loft meets the two extrusions turn from concave to convex inside their edges (at 67.8 degrees round them), where the offsets of their faces cross in an X; and Fillet5's rounding vanishes to a point where Extrude7's cylinder meets it at that point only (OCCT port patch 2418). Now one body with no warning (the volume measured with port patches 2418 and 2433; the OCCT lab's thick solid of the body as stored before, case 2418-pipe-shell, gives 2512228.5, Rounded 2511800.7).

Sharp with Fillet5 suppressed: the crease between the loft and its mirror image fades to tangency at both ends, where the offsets of the two sides cross; before, the shell said the wall did not fit under 5 faces and left the body solid (the kernel's offset failed, and so did the cavity). Now hollow (the volume measured; 2521317.4 in the OCCT lab for the same pipe built there from the stored loft).
